sources.prompt: Revise this Drain Damage concept card, retaining title01 VALVE-STEM SLALOM, DODGE label, pixel illustration style and PROPOSED CONCEPT—NOT IMPLEMENTED footer. CRITICAL gameplay geometry: eliminate BOTH straight edge bypasses. Show FOUR staggered valve assemblies mounted on solid broad brass/porcelain baffles. Baffle1 connects FLUSH to TOP/FAR bank and extends across65%ofchannel, leaves ONLY bottom/near gap. Baffle2 connects FLUSH to BOTTOM/NEAR bank and extends65%, leaves ONLY top/far gap. Baffle3 top-connected same as1. Baffle4 bottom-connected same as2. Every wall connection solid with NO water passage between baffle and bank. Longitudinal space between baffles allows a small hero on110px board to steer across. Oversized upright red-handwheel brass valve stems on baffles preserve plumbing identity. Large gold route follows forced near→far→near→far path; never crosses solid barriers. Main view clear side-oblique overview, enough space to show all four assemblies. Lower third MUST include a clean TOP-DOWN SCHEMATIC of straight horizontal channel: top-connected block then bottom-connected block then top then bottom, solid filled footprints; gold continuous zigzag only through actual gaps. Small Tony surfing short board on approach for scale. Keep both banks continuous; no escape onto bank. No numerical dimensions or timing claims.

Revise this Drain Damage concept card while retaining its rich pixel-game style, title09 BUCKLED DRAIN GRATE, JUMP label, short-board hero scale, turquoise water/porcelain setting and PROPOSED CONCEPT—NOT IMPLEMENTED footer. Make the grate unmistakably DANGEROUS TO TOUCH: several thick jagged RUSTED METAL SPIKES and bent broken bars protrude upward THROUGH the grate holes, serrated sharp tips gleaming ivory against deep dark slots. These are fixed broken plumbing metal, not a living enemy. Distinct tooth-like skyline across the low grate crest, some rusty dark-red corrosion but NO blood/gore. Keep total obstacle a low jumpable hazard, not a giant wall. Small black/yellow caution plates on end corners reinforce physical spikes; do not rely on color alone. Main hero and entire short board shown clearing the COMPLETE spike envelope in a gold hop arc with grounded water shadow and safe landing water beyond. Upper-right side-profile inset MUST also show spikes above grate and trajectory safely ABOVE tips, landing beyond last spike. No safe-looking flat route across grate, no ramp chevrons or boost glow. Do not add new damage numbers or timing claims.
